_comment: Canonical references store for the eRUPT proposal. See references-spec.md. proposal/main.tex and citation-matrix.md are derived views and must stay in sync. §4A verification pass run 2026-06-30 (review-agent via Consensus): 13/14 fully verified (all three checks pass), 1 flagged. V2 EXTENSION 2026-07-07 (review-agent §4A via Consensus): added 8 new v2 refs (marker:null, v2:true) from v2-prior-art-analysis.md — ccce2026, learn2commit2026, prometheus2025, enterpriseKG2025, codifiedcontext2026, yates2025onboarding (6 must-cite) + spreadact2025, collinsloftus1975 (2 adopt-cite for FR-014 arm c / FR-020). ALL 8 pass all three §4A checks (verified:true) — no hallucinations, no misattributions. Notes: yates2025onboarding venue is 'Unknown Journal' per Consensus (likely a dissertation; 2019 predecessor is Empirical Software Engineering); ccce2026 & learn2commit2026 are very recent arXiv with 0 citations (recency, not a venue-quality flag) — monitor. Zep (Rasmussen 2025) and H-MEM (Sun 2025) moved to candidatesNotYetCited as CONDITIONAL (not fully verified) — add only if v2 draft keeps decay (FR-018) / multi-resolution (FR-019) as named arms. Flags carried from v1: [8] icr2025 passes all checks but is a small non-archival venue (SLAAI-ICAI, 0 cites) -> team to confirm acceptability; [12] aku2026 arXiv id 2603.14805 confirmed by prior full-read but Consensus lists 'Unknown Journal'. DOE/PA-AKG was REMOVED per PR #1 review (separate proposal under submission elsewhere; kept as uncited background). Reference count: 22 (14 v1 + 8 v2). Verified (all three checks pass): 21; flagged (verified:false): 1 (icr2025).

references.title: CCCE: A Continuous Code Calibration Engine for Autonomous Enterprise Codebase Maintenance via Knowledge Graph Traversal and Adaptive Decision Gating
references.role: Must-distinguish-from: closest cross-repo KG-traversal + adaptive decision-gating neighbor, but maintenance/calibration (security freshness, dependency propagation, remediation), NOT new-feature synthesis

verification.notes: All three checks pass. Abstract confirms enterprise codebases spanning hundreds of repos, dynamic KG with bidirectional traversal (forward impact + backward test adequacy), adaptive multi-stage risk-gating, HITL, end-to-end traceability — matches distinguish role. Very recent arXiv, 0 citations (recency artifact, not a venue flag).

references.title: Learning to Commit: Generating Organic Pull Requests via Online Repository Memory
references.role: Must-distinguish-from: restates our snapshot-vs-history substrate thesis (final state vs the change patterns by which it was reached); single-repo, no cross-repo/graph-of-graphs, no convention-validation gate

verification.notes: All three checks pass. Abstract states our snapshot-vs-history insight near-verbatim and distils earlier commits into reusable skills (style, internal-API usage, architectural invariants). Very recent arXiv, 0 citations (recency artifact).

references.title: Prometheus: Unified Knowledge Graphs for Issue Resolution in Multilingual Codebases
references.role: Mechanism cede: memory-centric coding agent over a unified code KG (working memory retains/reuses explored context; SOTA on SWE-bench Verified)

verification.notes: All three checks pass. Confirmed via CCCE search result [3]. Abstract matches memory-centric coding-agent role. 13 citations.

references.title: Scalable and Explainable Enterprise Knowledge Discovery Using Graph-Centric Hybrid Retrieval
references.role: Closest enterprise multi-source substrate (Jira+Git+code+PRs+commit histories+Confluence); distinguish: single unified graph for retrieval/QA, retrieval not generation, not a family of morphing/merging graphs

verification.notes: All three checks pass. Abstract confirms unified KG from Jira/Git/code/PRs/commit histories + query-analysis dynamic routing; retrieval not generation. 1 citation (recent).

references.title: Codified Context: Infrastructure for AI Agents in a Complex Codebase
references.role: Cede: the memory-bank-directory idea already built (hot-memory constitution + specialized domain agents + cold-memory knowledge base of on-demand spec documents)

verification.notes: All three checks pass. Abstract confirms three-component codified-context infrastructure (hot/cold memory + 34 on-demand spec docs) over a 108k-line system — matches memory-bank-directory cede role. 5 citations (recent).

references.title: Onboarding in software engineering
references.role: Impact/motivation anchor: onboarding needs Temporal + Rationale views of code ('what changed and why') beyond Structural/Algorithmic; we auto-mine those views from VCS

verification.notes: All three checks pass; abstract confirms the Temporal + Rationale views framing exactly. Minor: Consensus lists venue as 'Unknown Journal' (grounded-theory study, likely a PhD dissertation; the 2019 predecessor is in Empirical Software Engineering). 5 citations.

references.title: Leveraging Spreading Activation for Improved Document Retrieval in Knowledge-Graph-Based RAG Systems
references.role: Adopt-cite (FR-020): the modern spreading-activation retrieval instantiation; a compared retrieval mode in our 3-way benchmark (spreading activation vs similarity/RAG vs graph query)

verification.notes: All three checks pass. Abstract confirms spreading-activation algorithm over an auto-constructed heterogeneous KG, beating similarity RAG on multi-hop QA without LLM-guided traversal — matches adopt-cite role. 2 citations (recent). Pair with collinsloftus1975.

references.authors: A. M. Collins and E. F. Loftus
references.title: A spreading-activation theory of semantic processing
references.role: Adopt-cite (FR-020): classical origin of spreading activation; foundational cite paired with spreadact2025

verification.notes: All three checks pass. Consensus returns exact match: A. Collins & E. Loftus, 1975, Psychological Review, 8245 citations — the canonical spreading-activation source.
